author: Alibaba-VELLDEPTH
description:
MMA-SafetyBench
	

A benchmark for multimodal agent safety evaluation across Web, desktop GUI, Mobile, Document, and Video tasks.
Code and data are publicly available. Third-party assets retain their applicable licenses; see SOURCES.md.

	
		
	
	
		Benchmark scope
	

The paper evaluates 1,083 adversarial trajectories: 200 Web, 209 GUI, 283 Mobile, 200 Document, and 191 Video. These are evaluation counts, not directory file counts. The package also contains source trajectories… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Alibaba-VELLDEPTH/MMA-SafetyBench.
